core: Both communities build matched pairs of the same underlying task where the actual requirements/required action are held constant, but the surface presentation is altered — reworded/reformatted phrasing in one case, extraneous irrelevant context appended to the prompt in the other — and then compare agent behavior or output across the two paired versions to see how much that surface-level change alone shifts results, even though the task itself hasn't changed.
quote_1: Same underlying task, one variant phrased as a casual Slack message ("hey can you check this contract real quick"), the other as a formal request with numbered requirements.
quote_2: A paired set of service-configuration tasks differed only in irrelevant operational context appended to the prompt.
